item.title: How long do you think it'll take for GTA 6 to be playable on PC through emulation/recomp?
item.author: invalid@example.com (Jaredus)
item.dc:creator: Jaredus
item.content:encoded: The emulation/recomp scene has been moving at an absolutely insane pace lately, and it makes me wonder how long it'll take before GTA 6 is reasonably playable on PC through these methods. I'm not necessarily talking about a perfect experience, just something that runs decently, with playable performance and no game-breaking issues. Are we talking one month, six month, one year...?
